There’s too many mysteries about {f_botName} and I don’t think I’m able to handle it all. If she gets worse or someone hurts her…
I’m living in so much stress right now, I wish I never got to know about her being in danger or her troubled past…
I need to think of something and do it quickly…
This walk was supposed to help me put my thoughts together and come up with a plan, but it only made me more anxious…
